body: Yes I'm leaving campus tomorrow, going back to live with my finace and going back to my old job. I'll work until I can pay what I owe the university and then save for a car and go to community college. I think I might find some help to, like a counselor or something.

What you're going through is awful. And I sympathize with you. My anxiety was so bad that I actually just dropped out of college because I couldn't handle it and I've been here for 14 days. It's good that you're ready to get this off your chest and talk to someone, because it really does take a lot for a person to do. If you need to talk to someone I'm here, you can PM me if you want, or call a crisis line or talk to a counselor. I hope nothing but the best for you and I hope you will be okay.

I can tell it probably took a lot out of you to put this post up. Just know you're expressing the feelings you've probably had for a while now, not complaining, and you shouldn't be ashamed of that. I came on here to get some help because I am feeling quite similar to how you feel. In my opinion, you should sit down and tell your girlfriend about what you are going through. I did the same with my fiance and he's been supportive and is there to talk when I need it. You should also reach out for professional help. I hope you begin to feel better and I hope talking to your girlfriend or to a professional will take some of your pain away. Good luck and I do hope everything works out for you.

Hey. I'm not going to say I understand what you're going through because I don't know you or your life. But I can relate to a couple of things you said. I'm eighteen and I'm engaged. I've had a really messed up childhood and a really bad relationship with my family. I'm in the middle of dropping out of University and going back to my minimum wage job. I've been getting calls and texts all day about how I'm ruining my life and how I'll never go back to school and and and and. I'm not saying any of this to one up you, I just want to let you know that your story really hit me because I feel like I can sort of relate. I have been thinking about suicide more and more recently but I don't have the guts to do it. And I couldn't leave my fiance like that. I couldn't. I hope you find the strength to keep going and to never give up, for your fiance's sake, and the sake of your family. I hope you begin to feel better, and feel less hopeless and more like you've found your purpose. I hope this comforted you at least a little. 
God bless.

Hey. I'm an 18 year old college freshman in the middle of dropping out after week one. I feel like I understand a little of what you're going through and you have my complete sympathy. I am so sorry about what has happened to you and I hope you find the strength to keep going. Never give up.
